notes.title: Patch Notes: v0.4.10.45 – The Foundations Update
notes.notes: [h1][b]Patch Notes: v0.4.10.45 – The Foundations Update[/b][/h1][p][/p][p]Hello everyone![/p][p]This patch marks an important milestone for our Steam Playtest: it lays down the foundations for accessibility, clarity, and smoother multiplayer battles.[/p][p][/p][p]With a brand-new tutorial, improved UI elements, and tons of bug fixes, this update is all about making the game more approachable while polishing the core RTS, deckbuilding and auto battler experience.[/p][hr][/hr][h2][b]New Features[/b][/h2][p][/p][h3][b]Tutorial Map[/b][/h3][p]Finally here: a dedicated tutorial map to introduce new players to the basics of the game. Perfect for newcomers and a great refresher for veterans.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Player Rank Icons[/b][/h3][p]Lobby and player lists now show rank icons for each player, adding flair and making progression more visible.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Level Cap Notification[/b][/h3][p]At the end of each match, you’ll now see whether you’ve reached the maximum level. 👉 For this Playtest, the cap is set to [b]Level 5[/b].[/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]Improvements[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Bases are easier to tell apart with improved color coding.[/p][/*][*][p]Team recognition improved thanks to reworked spawners.[/p][/*][*][p]Base capture is now clearly displayed with a percentage bar and instant update notifications.[/p][/*][*][p]Finished base captures are more visually impactful.[/p][/*][*][p]Multiplayer maps updated with rebalanced player starting positions.[/p][/*][*][p]MiniMap pings are now much more noticeable.[/p][/*][*][p]Help window reworked for better accessibility.[/p][/*][*][p]Loading screen redesigned and now includes useful gameplay tips.[/p][/*][*][p]Sharper text across the board for better readability.[/p][/*][*][p]All text input fields now support extended functionality.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where destroyed building plots couldn’t be reused.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where newly spawned units would occasionally ignore collision with a unit standing directly in front of the spawner, causing overlap/passing through.[/p][/*][*][p]Supply drops with rockets/missiles sometimes ignored helicopters ==> corrected.[/p][/*][*][p]Vehicles now drive at the correct speed in all situations.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed vehicles stopping despite having space to move.[/p][/*][*][p]Steam Card corrections.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed fullscreen-only startup issue.[/p][/*][*][p]Cursor now resets properly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed failed login attempt issue.[/p][/*][*][p]Server list bugs corrected.[/p][/*][*][p]Lobby crash fixed when a player was kicked.[/p][/*][*][p]Dozens of smaller fixes and polish passes.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]Community Thanks[/b][/h2][p]A huge thank you to everyone participating in the Playtest and sharing feedback – especially regarding the new Tutorial. Your input is invaluable and helps us make the game more accessible and enjoyable for both new and veteran commanders. [img src="https://community.fastly.steamstatic.com/economy/emoticon/steamthumbsup"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][/p][p]See you on the battlefield,[/p][p][b]General Front[/b][/p][p] [/p]

notes.title: Hotfix!
notes.notes:
- The quick start tutorial was not displayed correctly.
- Some missing translations have been added.
- Minor balance adjustments have been made.
- A bug in the lobby that delayed the start of the match has been fixed.

notes.title: Bugfixes & Improvements: v0.4.9.36
notes.notes:
- Fixed an issue where the game client could occasionally crash during the initial connection phase.

- Server connections at game start now tolerate slightly higher ping values. Previously, only near-perfect ping connections were accepted.
[i]Note: We're still welcoming feedback on connection quality to help improve the infrastructure for the upcoming Early Access.[/i]

- Improved the readability of card texts (adjustments to font sizes, contrast, and layout).
